caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, medium wide shot, pushing in slowly. In the cavernous, dimly lit bridge of a starship, sleek metallic consoles with glowing amber displays flank a massive, curved observation window. A female captain stands in the center midground, silhouetted against starlight. Outside the window, a massive armada of jagged dreadnoughts hovers in formation against a deep purple nebula. The fleet thrusters begin to glow with intense blue light. [Shot 2] A close-up of the captain's face as a blinding white flash floods through the window and the fleet jumps to hyperspace. overall_soundscape: low ship hum, rising electronic whine, bass-heavy boom, metallic rattling, then quiet room tone. non_diegetic_music: cinematic space-opera orchestral score.
